definitions.name: invoice-pricing
definitions.description: Prices a sales invoice: a discount and the VAT of each line, order discounts, shipping, totals and who approves the invoice. The VAT rates are illustrative.

businessKnowledgeModel.name: lineDiscountTable
businessKnowledgeModel.description: The discount of one line. The first rule that matches wins.

outputEntry.text: "Fixed book price in DE and AT: no discount"
"Hardware: 10 units or more, Gold and Platinum"

businessKnowledgeModel.name: vatRateTable
businessKnowledgeModel.description: VAT rate in percent by country and category. Exactly one rule matches (UNIQUE). Illustrative rates.

businessKnowledgeModel.name: taxFormula
businessKnowledgeModel.description: The VAT of one line: its net amount times the rate, rounded half up to cents.

decision.name: orderDiscounts
decision.description: Discounts on the whole invoice. Every rule that matches counts (COLLECT): they add up.

outputEntry.text: "WINTER26 is only valid from 1 Nov 2026 to 31 Jan 2027"

decision.name: orderDiscountPercent
decision.description: The order discounts add up, to at most 10 percent.

decision.name: pricedLines
decision.description: Every line priced: its discount from lineDiscountTable, its share of the order discount, its rate from vatRateTable and its VAT from taxFormula.

literalExpression.text: for line in lines return { product: line.product, category: line.category, quantity: line.quantity, unitPrice: line.unitPrice, gross: line.quantity * line.unitPrice, discountPercent: lineDiscountTable(line.category, line.quantity, customerTier, country).percent, discountReason: lineDiscountTable(line.category, line.quantity, customerTier, country).reason, discounted: round half up(gross * (1 - discountPercent / 100), 2), orderDiscount: round half up(discounted * orderDiscountPercent / 100, 2), net: discounted - orderDiscount, vatRate: vatRateTable(country, line.category), vat: taxFormula(net, vatRate), total: net + vat }

decision.name: shipping
decision.description: Shipping fee, flat and including VAT. The first rule that matches wins.

outputEntry.text: "Express delivery in the EU, small order"
"Standard delivery in the EU, small order"

decision.name: totals
decision.description: The sums of the priced lines, plus shipping.

literalExpression.text: { gross: sum(pricedLines.gross), subtotal: sum(pricedLines.discounted), lineDiscounts: gross - subtotal, orderDiscount: sum(pricedLines.orderDiscount), net: sum(pricedLines.net), vat: sum(pricedLines.vat), shippingFee: shipping.fee, total: net + vat + shippingFee }

decision.name: approvalFlags
decision.description: Why the invoice needs an approval. Every rule that matches counts (COLLECT).

decision.name: approval
decision.description: Who approves the invoice: the highest approver that a flag asks for, and every reason.
